# Assessment Overview

This directory contains supplementary assessment documents generated for the versioned WePush assessment report.

- [architecture-diagram.md](./architecture-diagram.md) - High-level application architecture and component relationship diagrams for the desktop application.
- [dependency-map.md](./dependency-map.md) - Declared dependency inventory grouped by functional category, with modernization risks and test dependency notes.
- [api-service-contracts.md](./api-service-contracts.md) - Best-effort documentation of the application's local service contracts and outbound provider communication patterns.
- [data-architecture.md](./data-architecture.md) - SQLite and MyBatis persistence model, entity relationships, repository methods, and sensitivity notes.
- [configuration-inventory.md](./configuration-inventory.md) - Inventory of build-time and runtime configuration sources, stored properties, secrets handling, and framework versions.
- [business-workflows.md](./business-workflows.md) - Core operator workflows for account setup, audience preparation, task execution, and result tracking.
